headword: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}

definitions.explanation: An employee hired on a fixed-term contract, as opposed to a regular full-time employee (正社員). The contract is typically renewed annually or at set intervals, but the position lacks the job security and benefits of permanent employment.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I'm working as a contract employee.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登用|とうよう}→登用：17153_touyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was promoted from contract employee to regular employee.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧や⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Even when contract employees do the same work as regular employees, there are often differences in salary and benefits.

notes:
USAGE:
A key term in Japanese employment culture. Japan's labor market distinguishes sharply between ⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧ (regular, permanent employees) and various forms of non-regular employment including {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}, ⟦{派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}→派遣社員：18875_hakenshain⟧ (temporary agency workers), and ⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧ (part-timers).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hire as a contract employee
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧: contract renewal
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from contract to regular employee

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧ (regular/permanent employee), ⟦{派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}→派遣社員：18875_hakenshain⟧ (temporary agency worker), ⟦{非正規|ひせいき}{雇用|こよう}→非正規雇用：20988_hiseikikoyou⟧ (non-regular employment).
